about_the_game:
Classic Blackjack is a focused single-player blackjack simulator built to feel like a real casino table – without ads, gimmicks, or real-money gambling.
Drag chips into the betting circles, play up to three hands, and enjoy natural pacing with clear dealer voice lines and clean animations.

Features

🎰 True casino rules – Blackjack pays 3:2, dealer hits soft 17 (H17), insurance, split and double down on hard 9, 10, 11, up to two splits, double after split, and one card on split aces.

🃏 Deck & shuffle options – Choose 1, 6, or 8 decks. Each shoe is built and shuffled with a standard unbiased Fisher–Yates shuffle, then dealt in order with no rigging or rubber-banding. A clear shuffle banner lets you know when a new shoe starts.

📊 Clear table information – Session goal and current session total shown at the top, plus Decks / Count / True Count for players who like to track the shoe. On-table reminders show “BLACKJACK PAYS 3 TO 2”, “DEALER MUST HIT SOFT 17”, and “INSURANCE PAYS 2 TO 1”.

💰 Authentic chip handling – Drag chips into the betting circles, play up to three hands at once, and watch winning, losing, and push results resolve with smooth chip animations. Blackjack pays true 3:2 using a dedicated $2.50 chip for fractional payouts.

🧾 Insurance made clear – When the dealer shows an ace, an insurance banner and on-table explanation text make it obvious what you’re choosing and how it affects the whole table.

🎓 Helpful onboarding – First-time tips show how to drag chips, place bets, and understand key table options so new players can get comfortable quickly.

🏆 Achievements & progression – Unlock Steam achievements for milestones, streaks, and playtime. Designed for both short breaks and longer sessions at the table.

🎧 Audio & presentation – Casino ambience, chip sounds, shuffle effects, and dealer voice lines such as “Blackjack” and “Place your bets” keep the game feeling alive without being over the top.

🚫 No real-money gambling – Classic Blackjack is a pure single-player simulation. There are no real-money bets, no microtransactions, and no ads.

If you want to sharpen your skills even further, you can add the optional Blackjack Trainer: Initial Deal DLC, which overlays training guidance on top of the same Classic Blackjack table (sold separately).
